TSMC January 2016 Revenue Report

Hsinchu, Taiwan, R.O.C. – Feb 15, 2016 - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced its net revenues for January 2016: On a consolidated basis, revenues for January 2016 were approximately NT$70.86 billion, an increase of 21.4 percent from December 2015 and a decrease of 18.7 percent versus January 2015.
